user.title: Entity Assistant
user.description: Add Entity Assistant. This provides services, a button, and an HTTP endpoint for exporting your entities, devices, and areas to CSV. No configuration is required.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Entity Assistant is already configured. Only a single instance is needed.

init.title: Export defaults
init.description: Defaults used by the Export entity list button.

export_csv.name: Export to CSV
export_csv.description: Export entities, devices, or areas from the registry to a CSV file inside the configuration directory.

return_data.name: Return data
return_data.description: Return columns and rows in the service response instead of writing a file.

max_rows.name: Max rows
max_rows.description: Cap the number of rows returned when return_data is on (default 1000).

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: File to write, relative to the config directory. Must stay inside the config directory.

export_type.name: Export type
export_type.description: What to export: one row per entity, device, area, floor, or label.

output_format.name: Output format
output_format.description: File format to write: CSV (default), JSON, or YAML.

sort_by.name: Sort by
sort_by.description: Column name to sort rows by (unknown columns are ignored; values sort as text).

sort_dir.name: Sort direction
sort_dir.description: Sort ascending or descending. Only applies when sort_by is set.

columns.name: Columns
columns.description: Ordered list of column names to output; unknown columns are ignored. Overrides preset.

preset.name: Column preset
preset.description: Named column set for the export type: minimal, identity, or stale. Ignored when columns is set.

only_enabled.name: Only enabled
only_enabled.description: Exclude everything disabled or hidden (overrides the include options).

domains.name: Domains
domains.description: Only include entities in these domains (entities export type only).

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Only include rows in these areas (by area id or name).

stale_only.name: Stale only
stale_only.description: Only include stale rows (unavailable, orphaned, restored/not provided, or not changed within stale_days).

stale_days.name: Stale after (days)
stale_days.description: Flag rows whose state has not changed within this many days.

utf8_bom.name: UTF-8 BOM
utf8_bom.description: Prepend a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel on Windows renders non-ASCII characters correctly.

remove_orphaned.name: Remove orphaned entries
remove_orphaned.description: Preview or remove orphaned entities, orphaned devices, and empty areas from the Home Assistant registries. Defaults to a dry run; pass confirm to apply. Requires admin.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Preview what would be removed without making changes.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Set to true to actually remove the orphaned entries.

get_download_url.name: Get download URL
get_download_url.description: Return a signed, time-limited URL to download the export directly from a browser. Response only; writes no file.

download_filename.name: Download filename
download_filename.description: Name for the downloaded file (sanitized to a basename; extension set from output_format).

expires.name: Expires (seconds)
expires.description: How long the signed URL stays valid.
